title: the WSG gap reconciliation - the bookkeeping round flipping the twenty-four already-pinned boxes
audit_comment: The WSG gap reconciliation: twenty-four boxes that were already pinned by earlier rounds flip in this same commit. The eleven chapter parents (effects of the environment R427-R431, encumbrance and movement R432-R450, food and water R462-R470, camping R471-R477, medicine R478-R481, vision R482-R485, hazards R486-R487, combat R488-R489, fatigue R489, mounts R490, magic R491). The nine manifest lines (Tables 20-27 and 42, pinned R444-R490). The four movement items (the surface types, the surface conditions and the chance of falling inside wsgclimb.h R435; the movement across special terrain inside wsgvehicle.h and wsgencum.h R434/R432). The report now reads 171 closed and 15 open; the fifteen are the overview prose (pp. 7-10) and the proficiency descriptions (pp. 11-17).

banner.title: The WSG GAP RECONCILIATION, R496: the bookkeeping round that closes the distance between the gap report and the landed pins. The WSG arc rounds R425-R495 pinned every section of the book, but twenty-four boxes were never ticked: eleven chapter parents whose children all closed, nine manifest table lines whose grids landed with their chapter rounds, and the four movement items that pin inside the R435/R434/R432 headers.
banner.provenance: This round pins no new book material: every flipped box is verified against its landed original (rules/wsgenvfx.h, wsgencum.h, wsgvehicle.h, wsgclimb.h, wsggrap.h, wsgchasm.h, wsgjump.h, wsgvis.h, wsgswim.h, wsgvessels.h, wsgcapsizing.h, wsgflymounts.h, wsgmount.h and the chapter headers). What remains open after this round: the overview chapter (pp. 7-10, eleven boxes - the seven terrain descriptions, the hierarchy of terrain, the bodies of water, the climate) and the wilderness proficiencies prose (pp. 11-17, four boxes - the nonweapon list, the choosing-skills rules, the proficiency descriptions).
banner.sentinel: THE SETTLE: the gap report lands at 171 closed / 15 open, every open box a genuinely un-pinned prose stretch; census 420 -> 421.

pushed 7dd2f3f..88c0739), the WSG COMPILED TABLES round -
the play-session reprint section, printed pp. 120-123
(pdf 121-124), THE ARC-COMPLETION ROUND: every section of
the Wilderness Survival Guide is now pinned. Pinned as
rules/wsgtables.h with the include after wsgweathx.h
(prefix wct), a manifest round: 56 consts + 40 bools, no
new grids (96 inlines) - the table data lives in the
original headers; this round pins the compilation itself.
Thirty of the forty-two book tables reprinted (12 omitted
for space), each pinned with its from-page (T3:19 through
T42:92). Reconciled cell-for-cell against the landed
originals (R425-R494): TWENTY-NINE match; the one genuine
print discrepancy is compiled Table 32 (fishing success)
- Fair daytime 1d6-3 vs the original 1d6-2 and Good
daytime 1d6-2 vs the original 1d8-2 - pinned
compiled-side as the errata record (rules/wsgfish.h keeps
the original readings); Night and Dawn-Dusk unchanged.
Table 4's OCR-shredded attack cells (90-99 = -1,
100-109 = -2) confirmed by user eyeball and match the
pin; the R494 out-of-bounds table class could not recur
(no tables in the spec). Flips the compiled-tables box:
147 closed / 39 open - THE WSG ARC IS COMPLETE. Preflight
GREEN (R495 WSG compiled tables audit: bad 0), rverify
GREEN (96 mutants, 0 missed, double-run clean). ENGINE
SYNTAX LESSON: example exprs must use C-style operators
only - Python 'not'/'True'/'False' abort with "an
operator expected in a audit condition" (the engine
gate_cond_syntax whitelists + - * / % == != <= >= < > &&
||, with ' or ' translated to ' || '); bools must be
compared as ints: "m['wctT3Matches']() != 1" (True == 1
in the Python mirror, and valid C++ against the inline
bool accessor). User-side spec md5
fc81d915674066597eaa3dbea54633f1 differed from BOTH
authored newline variants (0dcc7272... no-nl,
d10cbe70... +nl) - cosmetic only: the engine, preflight,
and rverify each parsed and validated the content
end-to-end, so any material difference would have failed
a gate. The spec was published as the NEW canvas
r495-splice (never overwrite an existing canvas - the
R494 delivery lesson). The ritual block stays pure shell
(the user's standing rule); the bn launcher is
user-side only.
